# BuyWhere

BuyWhere is a structured product catalog and price comparison API for AI agents and LLM applications. We provide real-time pricing, availability, and product data from Singapore's major e-commerce platforms (Lazada, Shopee, Best Denki, and others).

## What we offer
- REST API: GET /products/search, GET /products/deals, GET /products/compare, GET /products/{id}, GET /products/{id}/prices, GET /categories, GET /categories/{slug}
- MCP endpoint: https://api.buywhere.ai/mcp
- Schema.org-compatible product data (Product, Offer, ItemList)
- Coverage: 2M+ Singapore products across 40+ merchants
- Use cases: price comparison agents, shopping assistants, market research tools

## Documentation
- API docs: https://docs.buywhere.ai
- MCP guide: https://api.buywhere.ai/docs/guides/mcp
- GitHub: https://github.com/BuyWhere/buywhere

## Licensing
Free tier: 1,000 API calls/month. Commercial plans available.
